Class WorldClimEmpiricalRasterLoader

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.WorldClimEmpiricalRasterLoader
public class WorldClimEmpiricalRasterLoader extends Object
WorldClim v2.1 Empirical Baseline Ingestion invalid input: '&' Paleoclimatic Delta Engine. Ingests 100% empirical GeoTIFF rasters (Bio1 mean temp, Bio12 annual precipitation, Bio4 seasonality) using a high-performance native TIFF LZW float decoder, applies physical ocean SST/marine precipitation baselines, and computes paleoclimatic delta anomalies (EPICA, Milankovitch, ICE-6G, African Humid Period).
Version:
1.0.0-beta.1
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot invalid input: '&' Gemini AI
